templates.title: Board Memo
templates.description: Decision memo with resolution, plan table and risks
templates.assistant: Turn this board memo into one for my decision: replace the company, the resolution, the key figures and the plan table with my numbers, keeping the decision-first structure.

templates.title: Research Brief
templates.description: Findings-first brief with market sizing table
templates.assistant: Rewrite this research brief for my topic: put the one-line answer on the cover, three key findings, a sizing table and the sources I give you.

templates.title: Project Plan
templates.description: Objectives, scope, milestones, RACI and risks
templates.assistant: Fill this project plan for my project: objectives with measurable targets, in/out of scope, milestones with owners and dates, RACI and top risks.

templates.title: Meeting Notes
templates.description: Attendees, decisions and owned action items
templates.assistant: Turn my meeting notes or transcript into this format: attendees, decisions up top, discussion by agenda item, and an action table with owners and due dates.

templates.title: Mutual NDA
templates.description: Two-party mutual non-disclosure agreement
templates.assistant: Adapt this mutual NDA for the two parties I name: update party details, purpose, term and governing law, and flag any clause I should have a lawyer review.

templates.title: Board Update
templates.description: Quarterly board deck: asks, KPIs, status, risks
templates.assistant: Build my board update from this deck: list the asks (approve/note/discuss), headline KPIs against plan, workstream RAG status and exception-only risks using my data.

templates.title: Investor Pitch
templates.description: Problem, solution, market, traction and ask
templates.assistant: Turn this pitch deck into mine: problem, solution, market size, traction chart, team and the raise with use of funds, using my company's facts.

templates.title: Quarterly Review
templates.description: Quarter vs plan with segment variance and P&L
templates.assistant: Update this quarterly review with my quarter: KPIs vs plan, revenue by segment, P&L variance table, what worked and didn't, and next-quarter priorities.

templates.title: Product Roadmap
templates.description: Themes, Now/Next/Later lanes and milestones
templates.assistant: Rebuild this roadmap for my product: three themes with goals, a Now/Next/Later swimlane, a milestone timeline and dependencies/risks.

templates.title: Financial Model
templates.description: 5-year P&L, cash flow and DCF, formula-driven
templates.assistant: Adapt this financial model to my business: change only the blue input cells on Assumptions to my revenue, margins and costs, and explain the resulting valuation.

templates.title: Budget Tracker
templates.description: Budget vs actual by line item and month
templates.assistant: Set this budget tracker up for my team: replace the line items and annual budgets, enter my monthly actuals, and flag any line more than 10% over.

templates.title: KPI Dashboard
templates.description: Monthly KPI tiles, trend charts and targets
templates.assistant: Load my monthly metrics into the Data sheet of this KPI dashboard, set my targets, and summarise what changed in the latest month.

templates.title: Sales Pipeline
templates.description: Deals by stage with weighted forecast
templates.assistant: Replace the deals in this pipeline with mine, keep the stage probabilities (or set mine), and tell me the weighted forecast and the deals most at risk.

templates.title: Invoice
templates.description: Branded invoice with line items and VAT
templates.assistant: Create an invoice in this style for my client: my company details, their billing address, line items, tax rate and payment terms.

templates.title: Product One-Pager
templates.description: Single-page product overview with proof points
templates.assistant: Write a one-pager in this layout for my product: headline, three value props, three proof stats, how it works and a call to action.

templates.title: Certificate
templates.description: Landscape certificate of completion
templates.assistant: Make a certificate in this design for the recipient, programme, date and signatory I give you.

templates.title: Meeting Notes (Markdown)
templates.description: Lightweight notes with decisions and actions
templates.assistant: Turn my rough notes or transcript into this Markdown meeting-notes format with decisions and an action table.

templates.title: Project README
templates.description: README with quick start, config and contributing
templates.assistant: Write a README in this structure for my repository: what it does, why, features, quick start, configuration table and how to contribute.

templates.title: Research Notes
templates.description: Hypotheses, evidence log, quotes and next steps
templates.assistant: Organise my research into this template: the question, hypotheses, an evidence log table, key quotes, open questions and next steps.

templates.title: Task Log
templates.description: Sprint task log with blockers and decisions
templates.assistant: Set up this task log for my sprint: today's checklist, in-progress table, done items, blockers and a decision record.

templates.title: Research Paper
templates.description: Article with abstract, equations, booktabs table
templates.assistant: Draft my paper in this LaTeX template: title, authors, abstract, method with equations, a results table and references from my notes.

templates.title: Résumé
templates.description: One-page LaTeX résumé with clean section rules
templates.assistant: Fill this LaTeX résumé with my experience, education and skills; keep it to one page and lead each bullet with an outcome.

templates.title: Lecture Notes
templates.description: Theorem/definition environments and exercises
templates.assistant: Write lecture notes in this LaTeX template for my topic: objectives, definitions, theorems with proofs, a worked example and exercises.

templates.title: Technical Report
templates.description: Report class with title page, TOC and chapters
templates.assistant: Turn my investigation notes into this technical report: abstract, background, timeline, analysis, results table and recommendations.
